title: One-sided certification of surrogate near-minimizers: exact worst-case envelopes under strong convexity and smoothness
abstract: arXiv:2604.05678v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study target suboptimality for points that approximately minimize a surrogate objective. Unlike standard uniform perturbation estimates, the available comparison is one-sided, thresholded at a certified lower target level, and restricted to the entire surrogate-selected sublevel set. We first show that selected comparison alone cannot yield a finite worst-case guarantee, even for strongly convex quadratics with identical Hessians. A single scalar upper bound on the surrogate minimum closes this information gap and leads to a sharp general estimate. For pairs of $\mu$-strongly convex and $L$-smooth objectives, we then solve the associated worst-case information problem exactly. We obtain a sharp feasibility barrier and a dimension-free envelope; in its nontrivial regime, the value reduces to a scalar maximization over a compact interval. translated_title: 代理近极小点的单边认证：强凸与光滑条件下的精确最坏情况包络
translated_abstract: 我们研究近似最小化代理目标的点所对应的目标次优性。与标准的均匀扰动估计不同，这里可用的比较是单边的，以一个经认证的目标下界作为阈值，并且限制在整个由代理选择出的下水平集上。我们首先证明，仅有这种选择性比较无法给出有限的最坏情况保证，即使对于具有相同Hessian矩阵的强凸二次函数也是如此。对代理极小值的一个单一标量上界填补了这一信息缺口，并由此得到一个尖锐的一般性估计。对于由 μ-强凸且 L-光滑的目标组成的配对，我们随后精确求解了相应的最坏情况信息问题。我们得到了一个尖锐的可行性障碍以及一个与维度无关的包络；在其非平凡区域内，该值可归结为紧区间上的一个标量最大化问题。显式构造的一维分段二次目标函数在满足（条件）的同时达到该界。（注：原文摘要末尾不完整）
tldr: 该论文针对近似极小化代理目标的点的单边比较问题，证明仅凭选择性比较无法给出有限的最坏情况保证，并通过引入对代理极小值的单一标量上界，在μ-强凸与L-光滑条件下精确求解最坏情况信息问题，得到尖锐的可行性障碍、维度无关的最优包络以及可达到该界的显式一维分段二次实例。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that one-sided surrogate comparisons alone cannot yield any finite worst-case guarantee, and shows that a single scalar upper bound on the surrogate minimum exactly solves the worst-case information problem for pairs of μ-strongly convex and L-smooth objectives, yielding a sharp feasibility barrier and a dimension-free envelope attained by explicit one-dimensional piecewise-quadratic examples.
